articulation.instruction_en: For /iː/ the tongue is high and forward and the sound is long. For /ɪ/ the tongue is slightly lower and more relaxed, and the sound is short.
articulation.instruction_uz: /iː/ uzun va til yuqorida-oldinda. /ɪ/ qisqa, til biroz pastroq va bo'shashgan. Bu FAQAT uzunlik farqi emas — tovush sifati ham boshqa.
articulation.self_check: Say 'sheep' and 'ship'. Your mouth should change shape, not only the length.

articulation.instruction_en: Long, tense, tongue high and forward; lips slightly spread.
articulation.instruction_uz: Uzun, taranglashgan; til yuqorida va oldinda, lablar biroz cho'zilgan.

articulation.instruction_en: Open your mouth wide and keep the tongue low and forward. It is not the same as /e/ in 'bed' or /ɑː/ in 'father'.
articulation.instruction_uz: Og'izni keng oching, til pastda va oldinda. Bu 'bed' dagi /e/ ham, 'father' dagi /ɑː/ ham EMAS. O'zbek tilida bu tovush yo'q.
articulation.self_check: Put a finger between your teeth — for /æ/ the jaw drops more than for /e/.

articulation.instruction_en: Tongue mid-high and forward; shorter and less open than /æ/.
articulation.instruction_uz: Til o'rta balandlikda va oldinda; /æ/ dan qisqaroq va yopiqroq.

articulation.instruction_en: A short, central, relaxed vowel — the tongue is in the middle of the mouth.
articulation.instruction_uz: Qisqa, markaziy, bo'shashgan unli — til og'iz o'rtasida. O'zbekcha [a] dan farqli.

articulation.instruction_en: Open your mouth and pull the tongue back and low.
articulation.instruction_uz: Og'izni oching, tilni orqaga va pastga torting.

articulation.instruction_en: This is a diphthong: start at /o/ and glide towards /ʊ/. It is not a single pure [o].
articulation.instruction_uz: Bu diftong: /o/ dan boshlanib /ʊ/ tomon siljiydi. Bu sof [o] EMAS — lablar harakatlanadi.

articulation.instruction_en: Put the tip of your tongue lightly between your teeth and blow, with your voice on.
articulation.instruction_uz: Til uchini tishlar orasiga yengil qo'ying va ovoz bilan puflang. Bu [d] ham, [z] ham EMAS.
articulation.self_check: Touch your throat — it should vibrate. You should feel your tongue touch your top teeth.

articulation.instruction_en: Tongue tip lightly between the teeth, blow air — no voice.
articulation.instruction_uz: Til uchi tishlar orasida, havo puflanadi — ovoz YO'Q. Bu [s] ham, [t] ham EMAS.
articulation.self_check: Hold a finger in front of your mouth — you should feel a steady stream of air.

articulation.instruction_en: For /w/ round your lips like a small circle — your teeth do not touch your lip. For /v/ your top teeth touch your bottom lip.
articulation.instruction_uz: /w/ uchun lablarni doira qilib cho'ching — tishlar labga TEGMAYDI. /v/ uchun yuqori tishlar pastki labga tegadi.
articulation.self_check: Say 'west'. If you feel your teeth on your lip, you said 'vest'.

articulation.instruction_en: The back of the tongue touches the soft palate and the air goes through the nose. Do not add a [g] at the end.
articulation.instruction_uz: Til orqasi yumshoq tanglayga tegadi, havo burundan chiqadi. Oxiriga [g] QO'SHMANG: 'sing' = /sɪŋ/, 'sing-g' emas.

articulation.instruction_en: The tongue tip curls back slightly or bunches up, but never touches the roof of the mouth. In American English the r is pronounced everywhere, including at the end of words.
articulation.instruction_uz: Til uchi biroz orqaga buriladi yoki to'planadi, lekin tanglayga TEGMAYDI. Amerikacha talaffuzda 'r' hamma joyda o'qiladi.
articulation.self_check: Your tongue should not tap or trill. A trilled r is still understandable — this is not a priority.

articulation.instruction_en: Short and relaxed, lips only slightly rounded — shorter and more central than /uː/.
articulation.instruction_uz: Qisqa va bo'shashgan, lablar biroz doiralangan — /uː/ dan qisqaroq va markaziyroq.

articulation.instruction_en: Start with rounded lips at /ɔ/ and glide to /ɪ/.
articulation.instruction_uz: Doiralangan lablar bilan /ɔ/ dan boshlab /ɪ/ tomon siljiydi.

articulation.instruction_en: Start with an open mouth and glide to rounded lips.
articulation.instruction_uz: Ochiq og'izdan boshlab doiralangan lablarga siljiydi.

articulation.instruction_en: Like /ʃ/ but with your voice on.
articulation.instruction_uz: /ʃ/ kabi, lekin ovoz bilan.

articulation.instruction_en: The most common vowel in English. It has no strong colour: relax your mouth completely and make a very short sound.
articulation.instruction_uz: Ingliz tilidagi ENG KO'P uchraydigan unli. Uning aniq rangi yo'q: og'izni butunlay bo'shashtiring va juda qisqa tovush chiqaring. Urg'usiz bo'g'inlarda deyarli har doim shu tovush eshitiladi.
articulation.self_check: In 'banana' only the middle syllable has a full vowel: /bəˈnænə/.

articulation.instruction_en: One syllable in every word is louder, longer and higher. The other syllable becomes weak.
articulation.instruction_uz: Har bir so'zda bitta bo'g'in balandroq, uzunroq va kuchliroq aytiladi. Boshqa bo'g'in kuchsizlanadi va ko'pincha /ə/ ga aylanadi.

articulation.instruction_en: After a voiceless sound say /s/ (books). After a voiced sound say /z/ (dogs). After s, z, sh, ch, x say /ɪz/ (buses).
articulation.instruction_uz: Jarangsiz tovushdan keyin /s/ (books). Jarangli tovushdan keyin /z/ (dogs). s, z, sh, ch, x dan keyin /ɪz/ (buses).

label: Sentence stress: content words are strong

articulation.instruction_en: Nouns, main verbs, adjectives and adverbs are said strongly. Articles, prepositions, pronouns and auxiliaries are said weakly and quickly.
articulation.instruction_uz: Ot, asosiy fe'l, sifat va ravish KUCHLI aytiladi. Artikl, predlog, olmosh va yordamchi fe'llar kuchsiz va tez aytiladi. Ingliz tilining ritmi shundan kelib chiqadi.

articulation.instruction_en: Your voice goes DOWN at the end. Use it for statements and for questions starting with what, where, who, when, why, how.
articulation.instruction_uz: Ovoz oxirida PASAYADI. Darak gaplar va what/where/who/when/why/how bilan boshlanadigan savollarda ishlatiladi.

label: Initial /s/ clusters: sp-, st-, sk-, sm-, sn-, sl-, sw-, str-

articulation.instruction_en: Start the /s/ and move straight into the next consonant. Do not add a vowel before or inside the cluster.
articulation.instruction_uz: /s/ dan darhol keyingi undoshga o'ting. Oldiga yoki o'rtasiga UNLI QO'SHMANG: 'street' = /striːt/, 'sitreet' yoki 'istreet' EMAS.
articulation.self_check: Say the end of the word first, then add the s: -treet → street.

articulation.instruction_en: Your voice goes UP at the end. Use it for questions that can be answered yes or no.
articulation.instruction_uz: Ovoz oxirida KO'TARILADI. Ha/yo'q javob beriladigan savollarda ishlatiladi.

articulation.instruction_en: At the start of a stressed syllable, /p t k/ are said with a puff of air. After /s/ there is no puff.
articulation.instruction_uz: Urg'uli bo'g'in boshida /p t k/ havo puflab aytiladi. /s/ dan keyin puflash YO'Q: 'spin' ≠ 'pin'.
articulation.self_check: Hold a piece of paper in front of your mouth. It should move for 'pin' but not for 'spin'.

label: Final voiced consonants — do not devoice

articulation.instruction_en: Keep your voice on at the end of words like bad, dog, is, have. The vowel before a voiced consonant is also longer.
articulation.instruction_uz: 'bad', 'dog', 'is', 'have' kabi so'zlar oxirida ovozni SAQLANG. O'zbek va rus tillarida oxirgi jarangli undosh jarangsizlanadi — ingliz tilida bu ma'noni buzadi: 'bad' → 'bat'.
articulation.self_check: Say 'bad' and 'bat'. In 'bad' the vowel is noticeably longer.

articulation.instruction_en: Before a vowel the l is clear (light, live). After a vowel it is dark — the back of the tongue rises (full, milk, school).
articulation.instruction_uz: Unlidan oldin 'l' ravshan (light, live). Unlidan keyin qorong'i — til orqasi ko'tariladi (full, milk, school).

articulation.instruction_en: After a voiceless sound say /t/ (worked). After a voiced sound say /d/ (played). Only after t or d say /ɪd/ (wanted, needed).
articulation.instruction_uz: Jarangsizdan keyin /t/ (worked). Jaranglidan keyin /d/ (played). FAQAT t yoki d dan keyin /ɪd/ (wanted, needed). Ko'pchilik so'zda qo'shimcha bo'g'in QO'SHILMAYDI.

l1_substitutions.uz: har doim /ed/ deb qo'shimcha bo'g'in qo'shiladi

label: Linking a final consonant to a following vowel

articulation.instruction_en: When a word ends in a consonant and the next starts with a vowel, join them: an apple sounds like 'a-napple'.
articulation.instruction_uz: So'z undosh bilan tugab, keyingisi unli bilan boshlansa, ular QO'SHILADI: 'an apple' → 'a-napple'. Shu sababli tez nutqni tushunish qiyin bo'ladi.

label: Weak forms: a, the, to, of, and, was, are, can

articulation.instruction_en: These small words are almost never said in their strong form inside a sentence. They shrink to /ə/.
articulation.instruction_uz: Bu kichik so'zlar gap ichida deyarli hech qachon to'liq aytilmaydi — ular /ə/ ga qisqaradi: 'to' = /tə/, 'and' = /ən/, 'can' = /kən/. Ularni eshita olmaslik — tinglashdagi asosiy muammo.

articulation.instruction_en: For /tʃ/ the tongue touches the roof of the mouth first and then releases — it starts with a small stop. For /ʃ/ the air flows continuously.
articulation.instruction_uz: /tʃ/ da til avval tanglayga tegadi, keyin ochiladi — kichik to'xtash bor. /ʃ/ da havo uzluksiz oqadi.
